title: Task-scoped advisory file lease
description: A lease declares intent to mutate specific absolute paths during one task. Scope is deliberately narrow: only paths the FINALIZED task pack enumerates, including the skill tree when the pack declares it a source. Not the home directory, not glob patterns, not git worktrees. An advisory record alone is a comment; the enforcement point is the hook layer, which is the only layer proven symmetric on both sides.

task_id.description: Task this lease belongs to. A lease never outlives its task.

owner_surface.description: Bound cmux surface of the owner, so a stale lease can be traced to a live pane.

items.description: Absolute path. Relative paths resolve against whatever cwd happened to be active, which is exactly the defect that made the round guard's root resolution cwd-dependent.

paths.description: Every path MUST appear in the finalized task pack's enumerated paths. A path outside that set is LEASE_SCOPE_VIOLATION.

mode.description: exclusive: no other owner may hold any overlapping path. shared: concurrent readers permitted.

expires_at.description: Bounded TTL. An expired lease reports LEASE_STALE and is never silently reclaimed: silent reclaim is how a lease becomes theatre.

source_list_sha256.description: sha256 over the sorted newline-joined path list, so a lease cannot be widened after acquisition without changing its own identity.

reason.description: Optional human-readable purpose, e.g. an issue id.

released_at.description: Set on explicit release. A released lease no longer conflicts.

$comment: Conflict verdicts: LEASE_CONFLICT (overlapping exclusive path held by another live owner), LEASE_STALE (expired, requires explicit action, never auto-reclaimed), LEASE_SCOPE_VIOLATION (path not enumerated by the finalized pack). Motivating incident: mac_harness.py moved 834b6c73/L1931 -> 8201cd3d/L1944 during an active task while two agents independently recorded the same mutation from opposite sides, neither able to tell the other was mid-write.
